summary: Orkas publishes concrete single-run DeepResearcher numbers (e.g. 90.8/100 at 89.84 s and CNY 4.5818 vs 260.13 s / CNY 11.4010 earlier) only in a Chinese regression-test doc; the full audit is cited at Common/docs/evaluation/deep_researcher_agent_evaluation.md, which is not in this repo, and the 'Commander benchmark' / 'model canary' harness that produced them is also absent. The only runnable model benchmark shipped is the local-agents live runner (npm run benchmark:local-agents, 6 scenarios) with no committed results, and docs reference benchmark:kb-retrieval and eval/context-mechanism/run-benchmark.ts, neither of which exists; the README makes no quantitative claims.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
